question_text:
Implement an idiomatic JavaScript/TypeScript frontend utility for **Challenge #22: Modern UI Frameworks (React, Reconciliation, State)**.

### Problem Specification:
- Write an asynchronous or state-synchronization utility (e.g., custom hook, debounce/throttle, event emitter, or reactive state store).
- Handle cancellation, unmount cleanups, and race conditions.
- Adhere to clean closure scope semantics.
answer_explanation: Implements closure-based function decoration with cancellation and context preservation for Modern UI Frameworks (React, Reconciliation, State).

criteria.name: Functional Correctness
criteria.description: Passes all visible and hidden unit test cases without errors.

criteria.description: Idiomatic naming, handling edge boundaries and null guards.
